prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Scroll through to explore how desktop pets live on your screen and bring delight to your daily workflow."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe in the Cloud", "Signing in anchors your companion to your account so your pet state is never lost across sessions."]
2: ["Discover Your Perfect Desktop Buddy"]
3: ["Choose Personality Traits", "Select how active and vocal your desktop pet should be on your computer screen."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Docking...", "Your pet is being configured to run directly on your desktop system tray."]
5: ["Bringing Your Companion to Life"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet on your desktop. Access controls anytime via the system menu bar or tray icon.", "Start Interacting"]
7: ["Cloud Sync Active: Signing in protects your pet's identity, level, and custom traits from resetting."]
8: ["For best results: Use clear, well-lit frontal photos. Photos with clean backgrounds generate the crispest desktop pets."]
9: ["Say Hello to Your Desktop Companion!", "Click on your pet anywhere on your desktop screen to bring up controls, play games, or change settings.", "Launch Pet Controls"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos/information of the user
